affected_party: quality reviewers, incident owners, operators, and stakeholders relying on a prior qif-ledger closure
actual_problem: qif-ledger can close an incident and preserve prose reopen conditions, but cannot append late evidence, record a human reopen judgment, or calibrate the old closure against later outcomes
why_it_matters: without an append-only path, organizations either ignore late evidence or rewrite historical decisions, weakening accountability
why_now: v0.8.10 established closure ownership in qif-ledger and official monitoring guidance highlights delayed labels and longitudinal observation
